name: Mutable Dreams
author: Kid Bunka
tagline: Living sound worlds for the M-VAVE FM-1
description: An open source FM-1 instrument for generative ambient music, rhythms and evolving soundscapes. Arrange freely assigned tracks, explore Biomes, shape synth voices and lo-fi kits, record sequences, and connect MIDI over USB, TRS or Bluetooth.

hardware.compatibility_notes: BLE peripheral reception tested; BLE central role, physical TRS input and UC25HQ80 installation await device tests.

credits: Created by Kid Bunka; inspired by the open source work of Mutable Instruments, built with fm1-base and felucca-bsp. Independent from Mutable Instruments and M-VAVE.
